name: Kazhdomu svoyo
source:
Our protagonist's name is Nikita. One day, he ended up in a mental hospital, but somehow managed to get out. By a strange coincidence, our protagonist gets on a PAZ bus and ends up in Sovyonok. Our protagonist will be doing absolutely crazy shit and flexing.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1766606732]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们的主角叫尼基塔。有一天，他被关进了一家精神病院，但好歹设法逃了出来。一个奇怪的巧合，我们的主角登上了PAZ巴士并最终到达了Sovyonok。我们的主角将会做绝对疯狂的事情和弯曲。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1766606732]Steam[/url]]
